framesNotStacked: The frames in which the nucleus was marked are not among those being stacked.
sameMoment: The nucleus must be marked in two frames taken at different times, the first and the last.
needThreeFrames: At least three frames are needed to find the comet automatically.
notFoundAuto: The comet could not be found automatically: there is no extended object moving steadily across the frames. If the comet is faint or has barely moved, mark the nucleus with a click on the first and on the last frame.
nucleusNotMeasured: The position of the nucleus could not be measured.
